flagship.title: Cox Mountain and the Fews Ford crossing
flagship.standfirst: A 3.75-mile loop that crosses the Eno on a suspension bridge, climbs about 300 feet to the ridge, and comes back down to the water.
flagship.why_this_week: Saturday morning is the better half of the weekend. Friday runs near 90°F; Saturday drops to a high near 78 with a 30% chance of showers, and Sunday is wetter. Go early Saturday and the climb happens in the cool.

route.surface: Dirt, rocks and roots; good traction needed on the ridge

access.name: Fews Ford access, 6101 Cole Mill Rd., Durham
access.parking: Main lot at Fews Ford; arrive early on a fair-weather Saturday.

dog.water: River access on both sides of the bridge
watch_for: Slick rock at the water's edge
Other dogs at the bridge on busy mornings

photo.alt: Field print of Rupert beside a creek, wet, in his mustard collar, looking up and to the left; the water behind him printed in pale streaks.

local_trail.title: Carolina North Forest
local_trail.line: An hour of soft trail five minutes from town, for the morning the weather decides for you.

away_mission.title: Hanging Rock, Moore's Wall Loop
away_mission.line: A strenuous 4.2-mile loop to the tower on Moore's Knob. A full day, and the best one if the forecast firms up.

wildcard.title: Occoneechee Mountain, then the Hillsborough Riverwalk
wildcard.line: A short loop past the old quarry, then a slow walk along the Eno in town.

mission.text: Find the best wading spot within sight of the suspension bridge.

memory_prompt.text: Ten seconds of his first water entry of the day.

conditions.summary: Friday near 90°F. Saturday partly sunny, high near 78, 30% chance of showers. Sunday mostly cloudy, high near 75, 40%.

pivot.if: Showers set in before 9 a.m. Saturday
pivot.note: Switch to Carolina North and save Cox Mountain for a dry morning; the ridge rock is slick when wet.

practical.closures_note: Check the park's alerts page before leaving.
